headline: Going Commando's USA v1.01 passes halfway at 54.46% matched code
summary: Going Commando's USA v1.01 rises from 44.26% to 54.46% matched code, with 6,222 of 8,578 functions. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. The largest contribution carries 498 boot and level implementations from bigbeno37's fork and lands through #354, alongside smaller gameplay and effects batches. The last progress update separately records Europe/Australia at 4,612 of 8,672 functions and USA v2.00 at 5,856 of 8,634.
highlights: #348 and #354 describe the same 498-function contribution, and #355 and #359 describe the same five-function batch. Each landed set counts once.
Particle payload bounds, object sizes and return declarations are corrected without claiming extra matches (#344, #345).
#347 and #349 remove non-function catalogue residues and document remaining blockers. They add no newly matched C functions.
A separate home and comparison driver for functional C lands in #342. It is kept outside matching progress, and six hardware wait loops are labelled original assembly in #338.
More gameplay, effect and near-miss work lands in #357, #358, #356 and #360. Further batches in #361, #363 and #364, and a near-miss record in #362, remain unmerged.
